title: The 10 Best Hand Mixers for Baking
h1: The 10 Best Hand Mixers for Baking
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for hand mixers for baking, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at hand mixers for baking using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Cuisinart HM-90S Power Advantage Plus 9-Speed
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact storage case fitting mixer plus all five attachments, 9-speed rotary dial, 220W motor.
strengths: 220W motor moves through thick sugar cookie dough at speed 3 for 3 minutes without warming
Dough hooks and whisk make this the most complete kit for serious bakers
Graduated speeds 7 through 9 give more controlled meringue building than a 5-speed jump
Storage case keeps all five attachments organized in one drawer spot
limitations: Beater coverage is narrower than KitchenAid, occasional scraping still needed
Heavier in hand at 2.7 pounds
Dough hooks are limited to small 1-2 cup flour batches, not full bread loaves
features: Compact storage case fitting mixer plus all five attachments

products.name: Breville BHM800SIL Handy Mix Scraper
products.blurb: Key specs: Scraper beaters that contact the bowl wall each rotation, 240W motor, 5-speed control.
strengths: Scraper beaters cut manual bowl-scraping in a standard cake from 3-4 times down to 0-1
240W motor is among the strongestfor layered cake batters
Real quality-of-life improvement for anyone baking multiple times per week
limitations: Only justified if scraping is genuinely your biggest hand-mixer friction point
Heavier than KitchenAid or Cuisinart at nearly 2.9 pounds
features: Scraper beaters that contact the bowl wall each rotation
Reduces manual bowl-scraping to near zero

products.name: KitchenAid KHM7210 7-Speed Digital Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 7-speed digital control with speed display, Genuinely slow speed 1 for controlled syrup additions, Speed 7 builds stiff meringue peaks in 4 to 5 minutes.
strengths: Slow, controlled speed 1 makes Italian meringue's hot syrup addition genuinely manageable
Digital display shows exact current speed for recipes with specific speed calls
Builds stiff meringue peaks in 4 to 5 minutes at speed 7
Strong beater bowl coverage carried over from the 5-speed KitchenAid design
limitations: No dough hooks or whisk, not suited to bread or pizza dough at all
Heavier than the 5-speed KitchenAid
features: Genuinely slow speed 1 for controlled syrup additions
Speed 7 builds stiff meringue peaks in 4 to 5 minutes

products.name: KitchenAid 5-Speed Ultra Power Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-speed slide switch, Wide-coverage spiral wire beaters, Single-button beater eject.
strengths: Handles everything from delicate meringue to thick cookie dough without straining
Best beater coverage of the bowl among mixers in this comparison
Single-button eject mechanism is reliable across years of use
Light enough at 2.4 lb for sustained baking sessions without fatigue
limitations: No dough hooks, so bread and pizza dough are out of scope
5 speeds is less granular than the 7 or 9-speed models for meringue specialists
No storage case included

products.name: SMEG HMF01 9-Speed Retro Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: Die-cast metal housing, Sealed motor rated for sustained use, 7-speed control.
strengths: Motor handles sustained mixing without warming, unlike most plastic-bodied competitors
Professional-adjacent build quality is the ceiling of the hand mixer category
Includes whisk and dough hooks as standard equipment
limitations: Lowest rating count of the top picks (1,800), less proven long-term track record
features: Sealed motor rated for sustained use

products.name: Cuisinart HM-90S with Storage Case
products.blurb: Key specs: Compact storage case fitting mixer plus all five attachments, 9-speed rotary dial, 220W motor.
strengths: Case holds all five attachments plus the mixer with cord stowed in roughly 11x6x5 inches
Keeps the whisk and dough hooks from getting lost in a separate drawer
Same reliable 220W motor and 9-speed control as the standard HM-90S
limitations: Case lid is stiff when new and loosens only with repeated use
Adds bulk versus storing just the mixer and beaters on the counter
Not meaningfully different in mixing performance from the standard HM-90S
features: Compact storage case fitting mixer plus all five attachments

products.name: Black+Decker Helix Performance Premium 5-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 9-speed control with Turbo Boost button, 500W input power motor, Beaters, dough hooks, and whisk included.
strengths: 9 speeds give more control than most budget competitors offer
Whisk handles egg whites and cream effectively despite the low price
limitations: Plastic-feel build quality compared to Cuisinart or KitchenAid
Motor bogs sooner than the 220W Cuisinart under thick dough loads
No storage case despite the multi-attachment kit
features: Beaters, dough hooks, and whisk included

products.name: Hamilton Beach 6-Speed Hand Mixer with Snap-On Case
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-speed control, Snap-on storage case, Standard wire beaters.
strengths: Handles standard cake batter, cookies, and whipped cream without complaint
Snap-on case keeps beaters together between uses
limitations: No dough hooks or whisk, so bread and meringue specialists should look elsewhere
Motor is not built for thick cookie dough or sustained heavy mixing
Best suited to casual, occasional baking rather than serious baking sessions

products.name: Dash Compact Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: Collapsible compact design, Compact storage case, Standard wire beaters.
strengths: Well suited to small-batch mixing, single-layer cakes, small cookie batches
Smallest storage footprint of any mixer in this category
Adequate motor for light to medium baking tasks
limitations: Not rated for heavy dough, large batches, or extended mixing sessions
No dough hooks or whisk, ruling out bread and meringue specialists
Motor lacks the headroom of the Cuisinart or KitchenAid models

products.name: Black+Decker MX3200B 6-Speed Hand Mixer
products.blurb: Key specs: 6-speed control, 250W motor, One dough hook included.
strengths: Includes a dough hook at a price where most competitors offer beaters only
250W motor is adequate for standard cake and cookie baking
Solid mid-budget alternative when the Hamilton Beach is unavailable
limitations: Single dough hook rather than a matched pair limits kneading versatility
No whisk attachment for meringue or whipped cream specialists
Slightly heavier than the comparable Hamilton Beach

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
